item.title: Gilded Rose Kata for Info3
item.description:
The Gilded Rose, Trade District, World of Warcraft.

This has been a lab exercise for info3 for many years.

Python Scaffold: https://github.com/htw-imi-info3/gilded-rose

The Gilded Rose Kata

– Working with Legacy Code and Refactoring to Patterns –

Introduction

About Coding Katas

The Term ‘Kata’ is a Metaphor taken from Martial Arts for a Pattern of Movements to Practice and Perfect those same Movements (Wikipedia:Kata). According to (Wikipedia:Kata), it was introduced as a practice to Software Craftsmanship by Dave Thomas in his blog, to practice developing software using techniques like TDD, Refactoring or the SOLID principles. There are several Code Kata Collections; see Kata-Log for an example that can be browsed by topic and constraint.
